content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The Airports Authority of India is engaging consultants in various disciplines for its Southern Region. The initial engagement period is one year, with provisions for extension subject to the prescribed conditions. Candidates can check the recruitment details below.

rows.airports_authority_of_india_aai: Senior Consultant, Consultant, Junior Consultant and Associate Consultant
Relevant Bachelor's Degree, Engineering Degree, Postgraduate Degree or other prescribed professional qualification
Up to 30, 35, 40 or 45 years, depending on the post

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: AAI has extended the online application deadline through Corrigendum-01. The original closing date was 27 October 2026, but candidates can now submit applications until 10 November 2026. The schedule for document verification and interview will be communicated separately.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 18 consultant vacancies have been announced across 13 position categories. The vacancies cover clinical psychology, airport systems, wildlife management, aerodrome safeguarding, horticulture, law, media and technical services.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 must be Indian nationals and possess the prescribed educational qualifications and post-qualification experience for the relevant position. The requirements vary by discipline and consultant level. Applicants should review the complete educational, experience, portfolio and desirable qualification requirements in the official notification before submitting their application.

rows.qualification: Postgraduation in Psychology with clinical exposure
rows.experience_required: 3-5 years of post-qualification experience in a clinical or organisational setting, or 2 years as a Psychologist in an IAF Boarding Centre. Additional desirable qualifications are specified in the advertisement.

rows.qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication or Electronics & Instrumentation
rows.experience_required: 3-5 years in project management, execution or tendering in Electronics Systems

rows.qualification: Master's Degree in Wildlife Science, Zoology, Environmental Science, Life Sciences or related fields
Master's Degree in Wildlife Science, Zoology, Environmental Science, Life Sciences or related fields

rows.experience_required: 3-5 years of relevant experience, including areas such as land records, surveying and GIS tools
0-3 years of relevant experience in the prescribed areas

rows.qualification: M.Sc. in Agriculture/Horticulture or equivalent, preferably with exposure to Landscape and Aesthetics
rows.experience_required: 5-8 years of post-qualification experience in the executive cadre

rows.qualification: Regular 3-year Law Degree after graduation or 5-year integrated Law Degree after 10+2, with eligibility for enrolment as an Advocate
Bachelor's Degree in Mass Communication, Journalism or English Literature; alternatively, any Bachelor's Degree with a Master's Degree in Mass Communication or Journalism
rows.experience_required: 5-8 years of experience in content writing, copywriting or editorial roles

rows.qualification: Bachelor's Degree with Advanced Diploma/Degree in Multimedia, Animation, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design or related disciplines
rows.experience_required: 5-8 years of relevant experience, with portfolio and design leadership requirements

rows.qualification: Bachelor's Degree with Diploma/Degree in Film Production, Media Studies, Mass Communication, Visual Arts or Animation
rows.experience_required: 5-8 years of professional video editing experience

rows.qualification: Full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering
Full-time regular Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive consolidated fixed monthly remuneration based on the consultant position. The advertised monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 and is all-inclusive.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: AAI will select eligible candidates through document verification and interview. According to the official notification, candidates must secure a minimum of 50 marks in the interview for selection based on merit ranking. Document Verification: Verification of educational qualifications, experience certificates and other prescribed documents. Interview: Assessment of eligible candidates based on the requirements of the relevant consultant position. Merit-Based Selection: Selection based on interview merit ranking, subject to the prescribed minimum of 50 marks. The document verification and interview schedule will be communicated later by AAI.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The initial consultant engagement will be for one year. The contract may be extended for another year at a time, subject to the applicable conditions, with a maximum cumulative engagement period of five years. The assignment is full-time, and selected consultants cannot undertake another assignment during their consultancy period. They will be engaged as independent consultants rather than regular AAI employees.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for AAI Consultant Online Application 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should prepare the following documents in the formats and file sizes prescribed by AAI before completing the online application.

rows.file_requirements: JPEG/JPG, 80-150 KB, black ink on white paper

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 through the official recruitment portal before 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: AAI has also issued Corrigendum-01 extending the last date for online applications to 10 November 2026 and clarifying the experience heading in the vacancy table. Candidates should read both documents before applying. Check AAI Consultant Recruitment Notification

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Apply Online Link
content_sections.text: The online application process for the AAI Southern Region consultant vacancies began on 7 October 2026. Following the extension, candidates can submit their applications up to 10 November 2026. AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) for various contract positions based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 18 vacancies have been announced for Consultants, Junior Consultants, Associate Consultants, and Senior Consultants across multiple specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process for AAI Recruitment 2026 commences on 7 October 2026 for all eligible and interested candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online has been extended to 10 November 2026 through Corrigendum-01.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode via the official website of the Airports Authority of India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Senior Consultant (Law)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a professional degree in Law, which includes a 3-year regular course after graduation or a 5-year integrated course after 10+2.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated fixed monthly remuneration and package ranges from Rs. 70,000 per month up to Rs. 1,500,000 per year depending upon the specific post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AAI Consultants Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises document verification and an interview, where candidates must secure a minimum of 50 marks based upon merit ranking.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is strictly on a contract basis for a period of one year, which may be extendable up to a maximum cumulative period of 5 years.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at https://www.aai.aero or utilize the direct notification and application links provided in the important links section.
